title: Once MettleUp Plus limits are on, the body weight and measurement charts still show every entry ever
what: MettleUp Plus says charts older than 3 months are paid. Statistics, Profile and the exercise chart ask the free-plan check before showing a longer range. The Body page chart for body weight and each measurement has no range at all and draws the whole history, so a free member sees years of body weight with no check. Today nothing changes, because the limits are switched off.
expected: When the limits are on, the body weight and measurement chart shows only the last 3 months for a free member, or the plan says these charts are free.
who: free members, once Plus is switched on
how_often: every time the Body page opens
fix_line: Decide if body charts are paid; if so, give the Body chart the same 3-month check the other charts have

title: A member back after 3 months who types their first name a little differently loses their saved workouts for good
what: The phone-number backup finds the saved workouts by the number. If that account was not used for 90 days, it opens only when the first name typed now matches the old one exactly (first word, ignoring capitals). "Rahul" then "Raahul", "Dr. Rahul" or a Hindi spelling does not match: the server quietly makes a new, empty account for the number. The member sees "0 workouts brought back", and from then on every sign-in opens the new empty account, so the old workouts can never be reached from the app. Nothing on the name box says the name must match. Members who stop for 3 months and return on a new phone are common in gyms.
expected: A returning member whose number matches but name does not is told that the name must match the one used before, and can try again before a new empty account replaces the old one.
who: members returning after 3 months on a new or reset phone
how_often: every time the first name differs after 90 days unused
fix_line: Ask once more for the old first name before making a new account, and say why
